retrievalProfile.description: A centered monochrome portrait of a male artist in a leather jacket, framed by elegant script typography at the top and right-aligned serif text.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, sepia-toned photographic portrait of a man with an afro and glasses, wearing a leather jacket, positioned on the left, with large script text across the top and smaller italicized text stacked on the right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame
Top-aligned display text spans the horizontal width
Right-aligned secondary text balances the subject's visual weight
Soft-focus background creates depth behind the sharp foreground subject
coreInvariants: Monochromatic sepia or warm-grey color palette
High-contrast lighting on the subject's face
Combination of large script and smaller italicized serif fonts

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up portrait, slightly off-center to the left, filling the vertical height from waist to head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and glasses, providing the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large top text, moves down to the subject's face, then follows the right-aligned text block downward.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Soft, blurred background on the right side provides breathing room for the secondary text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm grey/sepia mid-tones in the photograph
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal/black for typography and shadows
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright highlights on the leather jacket and face
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between shadows and highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses a fluid, connected script with high stroke contrast
Secondary text uses a traditional italicized serif with moderate weight
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Script for the artist name paired with an italic serif for the album title to evoke a classic, sophisticated feel.

preserve: Script style for the top line
Italicized serif for the right block

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, calligraphic feel of the display text

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Times New Roman Italic or Garamond Italic
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the traditional, elegant serif structure of the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned, high-contrast photograph of a man with an afro and glasses wearing a leather jacket, positioned on the left side of a square frame with a blurred, light-colored background on the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in a large, dark brown script font across the top. Add the album title in a medium-sized, dark brown italicized serif font, right-aligned in the middle-right section of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the script text at the top larger than the serif text?
Is the subject clearly positioned on the left?

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between subject and text

postGenerationChecks: Check for correct sepia tonal range
Ensure the subject's face is the sharpest point of the image
Confirm the script and serif fonts do not clash
recipe.reuseFormula: Artist Portrait + Top Script + Right-Aligned Italic Serif + Sepia Filter
